correctness.rationale: Independently derived ν=2+floor(h/|d|) from consecutive nonzero product intersections, including integer equality boundaries; every admissible finite nilpotent triple can be counted by shift, length and placement. Enumerating independently for N=1..16 gave the exact finite j-tail sum, with N(N+1)(N+2)/3 total. In real triple coordinates Jacobian 1 per sign, two-sign volume V=L³/3; the event h≥ra has volume L³/[3(1+r)], giving Pareto-II and P(ν>j)=1/j. Conditioning h≤H and integrating 2(1−h−a) over 0≤a≤min(h/(j−1),1−h) gives the stated two branches and c(u)/j. Harmonic tail implies infinite mean, α-moment cutoff 1; uniform Riemann sums produce finite mean logN+O1. Correct for N≥1, n≥2, j≥1 except ideal formula j≥2, 0<u≤1.
